skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corruption] on the target for 2 turns (reduces DMG reduction rate by 30%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 210% ATK DMG to a single target and grants an acceleration buff for 1 turn; if this attack lands a critical hit, the acceleration effect is guaranteed to trigger. Has a 100% chance to immediately raise the SPD of yourself and surrounding allies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 263% ATK DMG to a single target and grants an acceleration buff for 1 turn; if this attack lands a critical hit, the acceleration effect is guaranteed to trigger. Has a 100% chance to immediately raise the SPD of all allies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After each action, attacking a [Corrupted] enemy deals an extra 75% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After each action, attacking a [Corrupted] enemy deals an extra 85% ATK DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After each action, attacking a [Corrupted] enemy deals an extra 100% ATK DMG.
